description:
You are a technical writer organizing project documentation. There is a configuration file in INI format located at /home/user/project/config/settings.ini. Your task is to review and document the configuration settings from this INI file, then generate a summary file of all its keys and values in markdown format for inclusion in a technical manual. Your task steps are: 1. Ensure the file /home/user/project/config/settings.ini exists. 2. Parse the INI file. It contains at least two sections: [General] and [Features], each with several key-value pairs. 3. Create a new markdown summary file at /home/user/project/docs/config_summary.md. - The markdown file must have the following format: - A level-one heading (# Configuration Summary). - For each INI section, a level-two heading formatted as ## [SectionName]. - Under each section heading, list every configuration key and value in that section as unordered list items (- : ). - Sections should appear in the order they are listed in the INI file. - Example snippet for the format: 
# Configuration Summary

## [General]
- app_name: ExampleApp
- version: 1.0.0

## [Features]
- feature_x_enabled: true
- color_scheme: dark
4. When finished, output the contents of /home/user/project/docs/config_summary.md to the terminal so a reviewer can check your work. You must ensure that: - The markdown summary precisely reflects the current state of the INI file, with no extra whitespace or missing keys. - The order of sections and keys matches the INI file's order. If verification is required, you can check the contents of /home/user/project/docs/config_summary.md.
